scripts.dev: concurrently -n "zalo,backend,frontend" -c "cyan,green,blue" "cd zalo-bridge && npm start" "cd backend && go run ./cmd/api" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,blue" "cd backend && go run ./cmd/api" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && go build -o bin/api.exe ./cmd/api
scripts.test: cd backend && go test ./... && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
